title: EmoteButtons
wikitext: '''EmoteButtons''' adds a convenient menu to access emotes and slash commands via clickable buttons. == '''Installation''' == '''Manual Installation only''' # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Extract the .zip file, move the EmoteButtons folder from inside the EmoteButtons_v1.0 folder to your Interface/AddOns directory # Restart the game. == Git Links == * [https://github.com/crazypoultry/Wow1.12.1_Addons_Collection '''(crazypoultry)'''] == Usage == '''Accessing the Emote Menu''' * '''Main Button:''' Click the central "EmoteButtons" icon to toggle the menu. * '''Shift Click:''' Shift + click any button to open its configuration options. '''Navigating the Menu''' * '''Main Menu:''' Displays primary emote options. * '''Wings (Left/Right):''' Expand to access additional emote decks. * '''Decks:''' Select different decks (Deck 1 to Deck 8) for custom emotes. * '''Emote/Slash Command:''' Click a button to send the associated slash command or emote directly in chat. '''Customizing Emotes''' * Shift + click on a button to configure or assign a new slash command/emote. * Use the deck selection menu to set custom images for decks. == Preview == Option: [[File:EBO.png|frameless|580x580px]] Buttons: [[File:Emote.png|border|frameless|210x210px]] == Features == '''Main Button''' * '''Right-click Drag''' to move the menu around the screen. * '''Left click:''' Toggle main menu (show/hide primary emotes). * '''Hover:''' Displays tooltip with description. '''Emote/Wing Buttons''' * '''Shift click:''' Configure individual buttons. * '''Click:''' Execute the assigned emote or slash command. * '''Hover:''' Tooltip shows the command and description. '''Decks & Wings''' * Easily switch between different decks (e.g., for different emote sets). * Left and right wings can hold additional emotes or commands. * Select a deck to change the images/icons representing the emotes. '''Image Selector''' * Click on images to assign a new icon to an emote. * Use the slider to browse through available icons. * Hover over icons for preview. [[Category:Addon]]
